prompt: For each pair of overlapping price windows, how many days do they share? This table may hold errors. A product's price windows should never overlap. A window runs from valid_from to valid_to, both days included, and a missing valid_to means the window is still open: an open window never ends. Two windows of one product overlap when the one that starts later starts on or before the day the one that starts first ends. A window can sit wholly inside another. The shared days run from the later-starting window's valid_from to whichever of the two valid_to dates comes first, both days included, and shared_days is missing when both windows are still open. Return three columns, in this order: product_id, valid_from, the later-starting window's start, and shared_days. Return one row for each pair of overlapping windows. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, work out the last shared day of each pair: the earlier of the two valid_to dates.
A later window with a missing valid_to is still open, so the earlier window's end is the last shared day; both end days count, so add 1.
why_this_works: A date minus a date leaves one end day out, so adding 1 counts both the first and the last shared day.
